create_benchmarks_entry_from_uris: create a BenchmarksEntry with a list of benchmark URIs to iterate over specific benchmarks
create_benchmarks_entry_from_dataset: create a BenchmarksEntry with a dataset name and max_benchmarks limit to iterate over a dataset
iterate_benchmarks_from_entry: run the benchmarks_iterator method on a BenchmarksEntry to yield Benchmark objects from an LlvmEnv
iterate_benchmark_uris_from_entry: run the benchmark_uris_iterator method on a BenchmarksEntry to yield benchmark URI strings from an LlvmEnv
iterate_benchmarks_from_collection: run the benchmarks_iterator method on a Benchmarks collection to yield all Benchmark objects across entries
